text: These **flat and wide** guardrail endings that bend away from the road can often be found in Albania.
NOTE: The same endings are found in Italy.
text_zh: 在阿爾巴尼亞，經常可以看到這種**扁平寬大**、且向道路外側彎曲的護欄末端。
注意：義大利也有相同的護欄末端。

text: Albania only has a few divided highways covered on Street View. All of these and how to differentiate them will be covered in the tips below.
The most easily recognisable divided highway is the A1 between Fushë Milot and Thumanë, which is the only one with a **triple guardrail**.
text_zh: 阿爾巴尼亞只有少數幾條分隔式高速公路有街景覆蓋（coverage）。這些道路以及如何區分它們的技巧將在下方說明。
最容易辨識的分隔式高速公路是富舍米洛特（Fushë Milot）和圖馬納（Thumanë）之間的 A1 道路，這是唯一一條設有 **三層護欄** 的道路。

text: The sections of the SH2 between Durrës and Tirana and of the SH4 between Lushnjë and Rrogozhinë are both divided by **simple concrete blocks**.
text_zh: 都拉斯（Durrës）和地拉那（Tirana）之間的 SH2 路段，以及盧什涅（Lushnjë）和羅戈日納（Rrogozhinë）之間的 SH4 路段，兩者都以 **簡單的水泥塊** 分隔。

text: In Tirana, Durrës and on the A3 and SH3 south of Tirana you can find highways which are divided by concrete blocks, with **grass and greenery **in between.
text_zh: 在地拉那（Tirana）、都拉斯（Durrës），以及地拉那南部的 A3 和 SH3 道路上，你可以找到以水泥塊分隔，中間夾有 **草地和綠植** 的高速公路。

text: Most of the SH4 between Durrës and Fier is divided by a **basic double guardrail**. The road does not go through any mountains.
text_zh: 都拉斯（Durrës）和費爾（Fier）之間的大部分 SH4 道路都以 **基本的雙層護欄** 分隔。這條路沒有穿過任何山區。

text: The E851 is the only divided road with a basic double guardrail that goes directly **through mountains**.

NOTE: A section of the A3 goes through the mountains but is either divided by a double guardrail with a [fence](https://goo.gl/maps/sEhkf36gQT4r56yMA) above, or with [concrete blocks](https://goo.gl/maps/59RXBrWohChLHePS9).
text_zh: E851 是唯一一條設有基本雙層護欄，並直接 **穿過山區** 的分隔式道路。
注意：A3 的某個路段雖然穿過山區，但其分隔方式要不是雙層護欄上方有 [圍籬](https://goo.gl/maps/sEhkf36gQT4r56yMA)，要不就是使用 [水泥塊](https://goo.gl/maps/59RXBrWohChLHePS9)。

text: The A2 north of Vlorë can be recognised by the fairly flat surroundings combined with the double guardrail with an **extra tall fence** dividing the highway.
text_zh: 夫羅勒以北的 A2 公路，其周遭環境相當平坦，並結合了以**超高圍籬**區隔高速公路的雙層護欄，可供辨識。

text: The **single-lane** bridge, connecting the islands of Manu’a and Olosega, can be easily recognized by the thin wire guardrail, with the two islands on either side of the bridge.
text_zh: 連接Manu’a島和Olosega島的**單車道**橋樑，很容易透過其細長的鋼絲護欄辨識出來，橋的兩側各有一個島嶼。

text: Andorra uses **yellow** reflectors on its guardrails.
NOTE: Within Europe, yellow reflectors are only found in Andorra, Spain and Belgium. For a good overview of European guardrails, see [this infographic](/images/andorra/europeguardrail.png).
text_zh: 安道爾在其護欄上使用**黃色**反光板。
注意：在歐洲，黃色反光片只出現在安道爾、西班牙和比利時。如需歐洲護欄的詳細概覽，請參閱[此資訊圖表](/images/andorra/europeguardrail.png)。

text: **Yellow and red rectangular reflectors** can often be seen on Argentinian guardrails.

NOTE: Within South America, they can also be found in Uruguay.** **However, Uruguayan guardrails can be differentiated from Argentinian guardrails by the shape of their [support](/images/argentina/argentinauruguay_guardrailsupport.jpg).
text_zh: 阿根廷的護欄上經常可以看到**黃紅相間的矩形反光板**。
注意：在南美洲，烏拉圭也可能出現。** **然而，烏拉圭的護欄可以透過其 [支架](/images/argentina/argentinauruguay_guardrailsupport.jpg) 的形狀與阿根廷的護欄區分開來。

text: This **guardrail ending**, featuring a black dash on a yellow background, is almost exclusive to New South Wales and the ACT.
text_zh: 這種黃底黑短線的**護欄末端**幾乎僅見於新南威爾斯州與澳洲首都領地。

text: Belgium uses A-type guardrails with **yellow **reflectors.

NOTE: In Europe, only Spain, Andorra, and Belgium use these reflectors. For a good overview of European guardrails, see [this infographic](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/60f6054f4e76b03092956de8/930bd2e7-57fa-4807-8e8a-733ba5a702a8/europeguardrail.png?format=2500w).
text_zh: 比利時使用帶有**黃色**反射片的 A 型護欄。
備註：在歐洲，只有西班牙、安道爾和比利時使用這些反射片。關於歐洲護欄的良好概覽，請參見[這張圖表](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/60f6054f4e76b03092956de8/930bd2e7-57fa-4807-8e8a-733ba5a702a8/europeguardrail.png?format=2500w)。

text: Bhutan commonly uses these **stone blocks** as safety barriers on winding rural roads. These blocks are very common and often one of the best ways to recognize rural Bhutan rounds.
Guardrails, on the other hand, are rare.
text_zh: 不丹經常在蜿蜒的鄉村道路上使用這種**石塊**作為安全護欄。這些石塊非常常見，通常是辨識不丹鄉村道路的最佳方法之一。
另一方面，護欄則很罕見。

text: Guardrails sometimes feature **yellow and black **markings. These markings always have the yellow stripes on the outside.
NOTE: Peru has similar markings. However, in Peru, the markings have the inverse colour scheme: the black stripes are always on the outside.
text_zh: 護欄有時會帶有**黃黑相間 **標記。這些標記的黃色條紋永遠在最外側。
注意：秘魯有類似的標記。然而在秘魯，標記的顏色配色相反：黑色條紋永遠在最外側。

text: Curbs and guardrails are usually **striped**. Possible colour schemes are black-and-yellow, red-and-white, and black-and-white.
text_zh: 路緣石和護欄通常呈**條紋狀**。可能的配色有黃黑、紅白和黑白。

text: Québec has unique bollards that are always attached to guardrails. They are long, thin white poles with a **red** or **green reflector** at the top.
text_zh: 魁北克省擁有獨特的路樁，且總是附著在護欄上。它們是細長白色的桿子，頂部帶有**紅色**或**綠色反射鏡**。

text: British Columbia predominantly uses **concrete barriers** instead of guardrails.
text_zh: 卑詩省主要使用**水泥護欄**而非一般護欄。

text: This guardrail, with **small poles** connected by **three** or **four metal wires**, can rarely be found on major highways in Alberta.
text_zh: 這種由**小柱子**與**三**或**四根金屬線**連接組成的護欄，極少見於亞伯達省的主要公路上。

text: In Ontario, you will often see these types of guardrails. They consist of **cylindrical wooden posts**, held together by precisely **three metal wires**. Some posts are marked by a reflective white band.
text_zh: 在安大略省，你經常會看到這種類型的護欄。它們由**圓柱形木柱**組成，精確地由**三根金屬線**固定在一起。部分木柱帶有反光白色帶狀標示。

text: In Newfoundland and Labrador, most wooden posts on guardrails have this **pyramid** shaped top. Occasionally, you can spot them on [standalone posts](https://goo.gl/maps/hBq3pYWKuD2MkgFQ7) and [signposts](https://goo.gl/maps/grcv9vSj4wF5MUzZ7) as well.
text_zh: 在紐芬蘭與拉布拉多省，護欄上的大部分木柱都帶有這種**金字塔**形頂端。偶爾你也能在[獨立立柱](https://goo.gl/maps/hBq3pYWKuD2MkgFQ7)和[標誌桿](https://goo.gl/maps/grcv9vSj4wF5MUzZ7)上看到它們。

text: Croatia has **square (B-type) guardrails**.
NOTE: Croatia is one of the few European countries that use B-type guardrails. For a good overview of European guardrails, see [this infographic.](/images/croatia/europeguardrail.png)
text_zh: 克羅埃西亞擁有**方形（B 型）護欄**。
備註：克羅埃西亞是少數使用 B 型護欄的歐洲國家之一。若要全面了解歐洲護欄，請參閱[這張資訊圖表。](/images/croatia/europeguardrail.png)

text: The **Queen Juliana Bridge** is a wide four lane bridge in Willemstad. It can be recognised by the yellow and blue guardrails, and the view over the city.
text_zh: **朱莉安娜女王橋**是威廉斯達特一座寬敞的四線道橋梁。其特徵是黃藍相間的護欄以及俯瞰城市的景觀。

text: Czechia and Slovakia both use a **special** kind of **type B** guardrail, which is wider than the normal type. No other European countries use the same kind.

NOTE: While Slovakia occasionally uses [other types](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.3230366,17.9835001,3a,20.4y,23.89h,74.62t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s5f9kxEo5ASRM7Q3_L5wElw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) of guardrails, Czechia is fairly consistent. For a good overview of European guardrails, see [this infographic](/images/czechia/europeguardrail.png).
text_zh: 捷克和斯洛伐克都使用一種**特殊**的**B型**護欄，比一般類型更寬。沒有其他歐洲國家使用同種類型。

注意：雖然斯洛伐克偶爾會使用[其他類型](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.3230366,17.9835001,3a,20.4y,23.89h,74.62t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s5f9kxEo5ASRM7Q3_L5wElw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)的護欄，但捷克相當一致。若要概覽歐洲護欄，請參閱[此資訊圖表](/images/czechia/europeguardrail.png)。

text: Denmark has **square (normal B-type) guardrails**, with no reflectors.
NOTE: Denmark is one of only a very few European countries with this type of guardrail. For a good overview of European guardrails, see [this infographic](/images/denmark/europeguardrail.png).
text_zh: 丹麥擁有**方形（正常B型）護欄**，且沒有反光片。
NOTE: 丹麥是少數幾個擁有這種護欄的歐洲國家之一。若想全面了解歐洲護欄，請參閱[這張資訊圖表](/images/denmark/europeguardrail.png)。

text: **Double guardrails** are very commonly used. This is much less common in other South American countries.
text_zh: **雙層護欄**非常普遍。這在其他南美洲國家少見得多。

text: Guardrails in Guayas province are often painted **black-and-yellow**, as opposed to the generic silver or solid yellow versions.
text_zh: 瓜亞斯省（Guayas）的護欄經常漆成**黑黃相間**，有別於一般的銀色或純黃色版本。

text: Estonia has normal A-type guardrails with **no reflectors**.
NOTE: The other two Baltic countries can have reflectors on their guardrails. For a good overview of European guardrails, see [this infographic](/images/estonia/europeguardrail.png).
text_zh: 愛沙尼亞有著**沒有反光片**的一般 A 型護欄。
注意：另外兩個波羅的海國家的護欄上可能有反光片。若要完整了解歐洲護欄，請參見[此資訊圖表](/images/estonia/europeguardrail.png)。

text: The MR3 from Manzini to the South African border is **divided** by metal and stone guardrails, making it recognisable.
NOTE: This road is the only divided highway found in Eswatini.
text_zh: 從馬齊尼（Manzini）到南非邊境的 MR3 被金屬和石製**護欄**分隔，這使它很容易被辨認。
注意：這條道路是史瓦帝尼唯一的分隔公路。

text: Guardrails on the Faroes have yellow reflectors.
NOTE: Yellow reflectors are not found on guardrails in any other northern European countries.
text_zh: 法羅群島的護欄上有黃色反光片。
註記：其他北歐國家的護欄上都沒有黃色反光片。

text: France uses A-type guardrails, usually without reflectors. On rare occasions, you can find [thin B-type](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LZPs77QN14xKdL3RA), the standard guardrail in Czechia and Slovakia.
NOTE: Spanish, Andorran and Belgian guardrails use yellow reflectors.
text_zh: 法國使用 A 型護欄，通常沒有反光片。在極少數情況下，你可以找到[薄型 B 型護欄](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LZPs77QN14xKdL3RA)，這是捷克和斯洛伐克的標準護欄。
注意：西班牙、安道爾和比利時的護欄使用黃色反光片。

text: **Thin B type** guardrail, typical for Czechia and Slovakia, is sometimes found on **highways** in the northern half of the country, often coming from Le Mans, Tours, Paris, Reims and Metz.

NOTE: On the highlighted sections, thin B can be the minority guardrail, and short sections of any highway will have no guardrails at all. It is also more common on smaller roads in the North, but less consistent as a clue.
text_zh: 捷克和斯洛伐克典型的**細 B 型**護欄，有時會出現在該國北部半部的**高速公路**上，通常來自勒芒、圖爾、巴黎、蘭斯和梅斯。
注意：在這些標示的路段上，細 B 型護欄可能是少數，且任何高速公路的短路段都可能完全沒有護欄。它在北部的較小道路上也更常見，但作為線索的穩定度較低。

text: While most of Germany uses **B-Type** guardrails, A-type guardrails are common in the northwest, as well as in Rhineland-Palatinate and parts of Bavaria.
NOTE: There will always be rare exceptions. For a good overview of European guardrails, see [this infographic](/images/germany/europeguardrail.png).
text_zh: 雖然德國大部分地區使用 **B-Type** 護欄，但 A 型護欄在西北部、萊茵蘭-普法爾茨以及巴伐利亞的部分地區很常見。
NOTE: 永遠會有少數例外。若要全面了解歐洲護欄，請參閱[此資訊圖表](/images/germany/europeguardrail.png)。

text: In Hong Kong, you will almost **never** see striped kerbs, which are extremely common in Singapore. In addition, grey pedestrian guardrails are also common.
text_zh: 在香港，你**幾乎不可能**看到在新加坡極為普遍的紅白相間路緣。此外，灰色的行人護欄也很常見。

text: The Tsing Ma Bridge can be recognized by being the only major **suspension** bridge in Hong Kong. The bridge has two **ladder-like** support towers, and yellow and red guardrails.
text_zh: 青馬大橋是香港唯一的**懸索橋**，因而容易辨識。該橋擁有兩座**梯狀**支撐塔，以及黃色和紅色護欄。

text: While similar to the Ting Kau Bridge, the cable-stayed Stonecutters Bridge can be identified by the** lack of **yellow paint, and its **box beam guardrail** design, as opposed to the cable design seen on the other two bridges.
text_zh: 雖然與汀九橋相似，但斜張橋的昂船洲大橋可以透過**缺乏**黃色漆，以及其**箱樑護欄**設計來辨識，這與其他兩座橋上看到的拉索設計不同。

text: The Lugard Road trekker around Victoria Peak can be recognized by the distinct** black guardrail**, view of the skyline and tourists walking along the path.
text_zh: 太平山頂周邊的盧吉道徒步拍攝街景可以透過顯眼的**黑色護欄**、天際線景觀以及沿著小徑行走的遊客來辨識。

text: Both A-type and B-type guardrails are common.
NOTE: The only other Middle Eastern country where B-type guardrails are common is Turkey.
text_zh: A 型和 B 型護欄都很常見。
注意：B 型護欄常見的中東國家只有土耳其。

text: It is very common to find **double guardrails** in Italy.
text_zh: 在義大利找到**雙護欄**非常普遍。

text: Italian guardrails feature **red** front reflectors.
NOTE: This is most useful to distinguish Italy from Spain, which uses yellow reflectors. For a good overview of European guardrails, see [this infographic](/images/italy/europeguardrail.png).
text_zh: 義大利護欄具有**紅色**前反光片。
注意：這對於區分義大利和使用黃色反光片的西班牙非常有用。如需歐洲護欄的良好概覽，請參閱[此資訊圖表](/images/italy/europeguardrail.png)。

text: Italian guardrails commonly end in this distinct shape. The guardrail gets flatter, wider, and it bends away from the road.
text_zh: 義大利護欄通常以這種獨特的形狀結束。護欄變得更平、更寬，並且從道路向外彎曲。

text: Japan generally uses these simple, **white** guardrails.
_You can learn more about the exceptions in the region guessing section._
text_zh: 日本普遍使用這種簡潔的**白色**護欄。
_例外情況可參考「都道府縣專屬線索」那一節。_

text: Some bollards on the island of Shikoku can have a** black stripe** just under the reflector. They can be found normally, attached to [guardrails](https://goo.gl/maps/dMX9b98ZsCAwWVm27) or [walls](https://goo.gl/maps/ibVKyN6TkXVVCgNm7).
text_zh: 四國部分路樁在反光片正下方有一道**黑色條紋**。除了獨立設置，也會裝在[護欄](https://goo.gl/maps/dMX9b98ZsCAwWVm27)或[牆面](https://goo.gl/maps/ibVKyN6TkXVVCgNm7)上。

text: Green bands on guardrails are most commonly found in Oita and Miyazaki, but can be found on all of Kyushu.
text_zh: 護欄上的綠色環帶以大分縣與宮崎縣最常見，但整個九州都找得到。

text: These distinctive **yellow **guardrails can be found in the Yamaguchi Prefecture.
text_zh: 這種特徵鮮明的**黃色**護欄出現在山口縣。

text: You can find these **chevron-like** stickers, or more rarely orange ones, on guardrails** **in Hokkaido.
- On the [end](https://goo.gl/maps/9JKVotxnj4pqYvLz7) or side of a guardrail.
- Stuck to [metal posts](https://goo.gl/maps/iJBcacVCiaUCobVb8) between wire fences, which are often found in Hokkaido.
- On railings, which are often found on bridges, [underneath](https://goo.gl/maps/S75JPZKg6eYzrfAG6) the inside of the railing.
text_zh: 北海道的護欄上找得到這種**類似轉彎標誌**的貼紙，偶爾是橘色的。
- 貼在護欄的[末端](https://goo.gl/maps/9JKVotxnj4pqYvLz7)或側面。
- 貼在鐵絲圍籬之間的[金屬立柱](https://goo.gl/maps/iJBcacVCiaUCobVb8)上，這在北海道很常見。
- 貼在欄杆上，常見於橋樑，位置在欄杆內側[下方](https://goo.gl/maps/S75JPZKg6eYzrfAG6)。

text: Guardrail endings with these **red and yellow** striped stickers can commonly be found across Chugoku, except in Yamaguchi. They can also rarely be found in Niigata.
text_zh: 護欄末端貼有這種**紅黃**條紋貼紙的情形在中國地方相當普遍，但山口縣除外。新潟縣偶爾也有。

text: The mountains here can be characterised by **steep rocky cliffs** that can have a slight **purple or red** tint to them. Not much vegetation grows on these mountains - only some grass and shrubs. A small river also runs alongside the road. You can also spot these [brown metallic electricity pylons](https://goo.gl/maps/oscB5ajzy2rpkMi26) and [curved concrete guardrails](https://goo.gl/maps/4nGewnwYYuPECDwa8) on the sides of this road.
NOTE: This section of road features the Black Dot Mirror.
text_zh: 這裡的山脈特徵是**陡峭的岩壁**，可能帶有微弱的**紫色或紅色**調。這些山上沒有生長太多植被，只有一些草和灌木。一條小河也沿著道路流過。你還可以在這條路的兩側發現這些[棕色金屬電塔](https://goo.gl/maps/oscB5ajzy2rpkMi26)以及[彎曲的混凝土護欄](https://goo.gl/maps/4nGewnwYYuPECDwa8)。
注意：這段路段具有黑點鏡像。

text: Going further west, you will encounter a very **hilly** landscape. The landscape features a lot of **vegetation** - tall grass, trees, bushes. This road uses these [concrete barriers](https://goo.gl/maps/KP2sH81R7BDqb2wx5) as guardrails, notice the cement above the gaps.
The general southeast to northwest driving direction on this road is also worth noting.
text_zh: 再往西走，你會遇到非常**丘陵**起伏的景觀。這裡的景觀有大量的**植被**——高草、樹木、灌木。這條路使用這些[混凝土護欄](https://goo.gl/maps/KP2sH81R7BDqb2wx5)作為護欄，注意看縫隙上方的水泥。
這條路大致由東南向西北的行駛方向也值得注意。

text: Latvia has normal A-type guardrails with **white or red reflectors**.
NOTE: Estonia has no reflectors. Lithuania has orange reflectors. For a good overview of European guardrails, see [this infographic](/images/latvia/europeguardrail.png).
text_zh: 拉脫維亞擁有配備**白色或紅色反光板**的標準A型護欄。
註記：愛沙尼亞沒有反光板。立陶宛有橙色反光板。有關歐洲護欄的良好概覽，請參閱[此資訊圖表](/images/latvia/europeguardrail.png)。

text: Liechtenstein uses **black-and-white **cylindrical bollards** **with a white or grey reflector and a rounded top. They also often have a blue attachment on the side.
When attached to guardrails, they will use the [wedge design](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zDoFQvaitWHeGPhk9) instead.
NOTE: Switzerland can use almost identical bollards.
text_zh: 列支敦斯登使用**黑白**圓柱形路樁，配有白色或灰色反光片和圓頂。它們的側面也經常帶有藍色附件。
當裝在護欄上時，它們會改用[楔形設計](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zDoFQvaitWHeGPhk9)。
注意：瑞士也可能使用幾乎完全相同的路樁。

text: Lithuania has normal A-type guardrails with **orange reflectors**.
NOTE: Estonia has no reflectors. Latvia has red or white reflectors. For a good overview of European guardrails, see [this infographic](/images/lithuania/europeguardrail.png).
text_zh: 立陶宛有配備**橘色反光片**的標準 A 型護欄。
注意：愛沙尼亞沒有反光板。拉脫維亞則有紅色或白色反光板。若要全面了解歐洲護欄，請參閱[這張資訊圖表](/images/lithuania/europeguardrail.png)。

text: **Red** guardrails can be seen on the Amizade Bridge.
text_zh: 在友誼大橋上可以看到**紅色**護欄。

text: Madeira sometimes uses yellow-and black guardrails on its mountain roads.
text_zh: 馬德拉（Madeira）的山路有時會使用黃黑相間的護欄。

text: The road east of the plateau can be recognized by its unique mountain formations and the black-and-yellow guardrail on the side of the road.
text_zh: 高原以東的道路可以透過其獨特的山脈構造以及路邊的黑黃相間護欄來辨識。

text: Regular metal guardrails are rare on Gozo Island. **Low stone barriers** are more common instead.
text_zh: 戈佐島上很少見到一般的金屬護欄。取而代之的是**低矮石欄杆**更為常見。

text: Guardrails in Montenegro are often **rusted**.
text_zh: 蒙特內哥羅的護欄通常會 **生鏽**。

text: Montenegro is the only Balkan country where you’ll commonly see both [A-type](https://goo.gl/maps/fZCnn3jPH4By45ph7) and [B-type](https://goo.gl/maps/w9hnQsjxxJS2TbT1A) guardrails.
NOTE: For a good overview of European guardrails, see [this infographic](/images/montenegro/europeguardrail.png).
text_zh: 蒙特內哥羅是唯一一個同時常見 [A 型](https://goo.gl/maps/fZCnn3jPH4By45ph7)與 [B 型](https://goo.gl/maps/w9hnQsjxxJS2TbT1A)護欄的巴爾幹國家。
注意：若想大致了解歐洲的護欄，請參考 [這張圖表](/images/montenegro/europeguardrail.png)。

text: North Macedonia uses **A-Profile** guardrails, like most of Europe. The guardrails have red reflectors.
NOTE: Serbia uses B-Profile guardrails. For a good overview of European guardrails, see [this infographic](/images/north-macedonia/europeguardrail.png).
text_zh: 北馬其頓使用與多數歐洲國家相同的** A 型斷面**護欄。這些護欄帶有紅色反光片。
備註：塞爾維亞使用 B-Profile 護欄。如需歐洲護欄的良好總覽，請參閱[此資訊圖表](/images/north-macedonia/europeguardrail.png)。

text: Guardrails often have **wooden posts**.
NOTE: This is not common in Sweden or Finland.
text_zh: 護欄通常有**木製支柱**。
注意：這在瑞典或芬蘭並不常見。

text: **Rusty guardrails** are almost exclusively found in coastal regions, and particularly on the southern half of the west coast.
text_zh: **生鏽的護欄**幾乎只在沿海地區找到，特別是在西海岸的南部半部。

text: **Black-and-yellow** stripes on guardrails are seen throughout the country. You might sometimes find different designs, such as this [sharp arrow](https://goo.gl/maps/Yky9joENHb4taRnr9) design.

NOTE: [Similar striped guardrails](https://goo.gl/maps/aiVM5kgjv2kLebEk9) are also found in Bolivia. To differentiate them, just have a look at the outer stripe. Peru uses a black one, while Bolivia features a yellow one.
text_zh: 護欄上的**黑黃**條紋遍布全國。有時你可能會發現不同的設計，例如這個[尖銳箭頭](https://goo.gl/maps/Yky9joENHb4taRnr9)設計。
注意：[類似的條紋護欄](https://goo.gl/maps/aiVM5kgjv2kLebEk9)也見於玻利維亞。要區分它們，只要看一下外側條紋即可。祕魯使用的是黑色，而玻利維亞則是黃色。

text: In the Cordillera Administrative Region you can find **yellow and black** striped concrete guardrails.
text_zh: 在科迪勒拉行政區，你可以找到**黃黑**相間的混凝土護欄。

text: White guardrails with **three recurring black stripes** are unique to the region of Bicol in southern Luzon.
text_zh: 帶有**三道重複黑條紋**的白色護欄是呂宋島南部比科爾地區特有的。

text: Poland has **square (normal B-type) guardrails**, with circular red reflectors.
NOTE: Poland is one of only a very few European countries with this type of guardrail. For a good overview of European guardrails, see [this infographic](/images/poland/europeguardrail.png).
text_zh: 波蘭擁有**方形（標準B型）護欄**，並配有圓形紅色反光片。
注意：波蘭是極少數擁有這種護欄的歐洲國家之一。若想完整了解歐洲護欄，請參閱[這張資訊圖表](/images/poland/europeguardrail.png)。

text: Portugal uses A-type guardrails with **red reflectors**.
NOTE: This is mostly useful to tell apart Portugal and [Spain](https://goo.gl/maps/shMgzeFPhLmZMiqX6), which uses yellow reflectors.
text_zh: 葡萄牙使用帶有 **紅色反光片** 的 A 型護欄。
注意：這主要用於區分葡萄牙和使用黃色反光片的[西班牙](https://goo.gl/maps/shMgzeFPhLmZMiqX6)。

text: **Black and white striped guardrails**, kerbs and bridge barriers are common in russia.
text_zh: **黑白相間的護欄**、路緣石和橋梁防撞欄在俄羅斯很常見。

text: The Superstrada di San Marino runs from the border village of Dogana to the City of San Marino. It is the **only divided road** in the country, and the lanes are separated by a **metal guardrail**.
text_zh: 聖馬利諾快速公路從邊境村莊多加納延伸至聖馬利諾市。它是該國**唯一的雙向分向道路**，車道由**金屬護欄**分隔。

text: Serbia uses **B-Profile** guardrails exclusively.
NOTE: North Macedonia does not use B-Profile guardrails. For a good overview of European guardrails, see [this infographic](/images/serbia/europeguardrail.png).
text_zh: 塞爾維亞僅使用 **B-Profile** 護欄。
注意：北馬其頓不使用 B-Profile 護欄。若想大致了解歐洲護欄，請參閱[這張資訊圖表](/images/serbia/europeguardrail.png)。

text: Slovakia and Czechia both use a **special** kind of **type B** guardrail, which is wider than the normal type. No other European countries use the same kind.

NOTE: While Czechia uses this type fairly consistently, Slovakia also uses [other types](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.3230366,17.9835001,3a,20.4y,23.89h,74.62t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s5f9kxEo5ASRM7Q3_L5wElw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) occasionally. For a good overview of European guardrails, see [this infographic](/images/slovakia/europeguardrail.png).
text_zh: 斯洛伐克和捷克都使用一種**特殊**的 **B 型**護欄，比一般類型更寬。沒有其他歐洲國家使用同種類型。

注意：雖然捷克相當 consistently 地使用這種類型，但斯洛伐克偶爾也會使用[其他類型](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.3230366,17.9835001,3a,20.4y,23.89h,74.62t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s5f9kxEo5ASRM7Q3_L5wElw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)。若想全面了解歐洲護欄，請參閱[此資訊圖表](/images/slovakia/europeguardrail.png)。

text: Slovenia uses a regular A-type guardrail, like most European countries. This guardrail type has **rounded edges**.
This is mostly useful for 50-50s with Croatia, which uses B-type guardrails. This type has square edges.
NOTE: For a good overview of European guardrails, see [this infographic](/images/slovenia/europeguardrail.png).
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞使用一般的 A 型護欄，就像多數歐洲國家一樣。這種護欄類型具有**圓潤邊緣**。
這對於與使用 B 型護欄的克羅埃西亞進行二選一猜測時非常有用。B 型護欄具有方正的邊緣。
註：若要好好瀏覽歐洲護欄，請參見[此資訊圖表](/images/slovenia/europeguardrail.png)。

text: Spain has **yellow reflectors** on rounded A-type guardrails.
NOTE: Belgium, Andorra, Gibraltar and most Latin American countries also have yellow reflectors. For a good overview of European guardrails, see [this infographic](/images/spain/europeguardrail.png).
text_zh: 西班牙在圓形 A 型護欄上有**黃色反光片**。
注意：比利時、安道爾、直布羅陀和多數拉丁美洲國家也有黃色反光片。若要了解歐洲護欄的良好概覽，請參考[這張資訊圖表](/images/spain/europeguardrail.png)。

text: Within Spain, **black and white guardrails** are unique to Ceuta.
text_zh: 在西班牙境內，**黑白相間的護欄** 是 Ceuta 獨有的特徵。

text: The AP-15 in Navarra features unique bollards with a simple flat design and a square red reflector. Guardrails also have [red reflectors](https://maps.app.goo.gl/c9X1ak7KB5EhdDqRA) unlike the rest of Spain.
text_zh: 納瓦拉（Navarra）的 AP-15 高速公路上有獨特的簡單平坦設計路樁，並配有方形紅色反光板。與西班牙其他地區不同，這裡的護欄也帶有 [紅色反光板](https://maps.app.goo.gl/c9X1ak7KB5EhdDqRA)。

text: Taiwan uses these bollards with either two or three **circular reflectors** on a black rectangle.
You can also find these **lollipop** looking reflectors on guardrails, similar to the designs found in [Japan](https://goo.gl/maps/JvYoen6Zsh9iptr16).
text_zh: 台灣的路樁是黑色長方形上加兩顆或三顆**圓形反光片**。
護欄上還能看到這種**棒棒糖**造型的反光標，與[日本](https://goo.gl/maps/JvYoen6Zsh9iptr16)的設計相似。

text: The Provincial Highway 8 that runs from Taichung to Hualien is very recognizable, specifically in the Hualien part, due to the **yellow guardrail** that can be found all throughout the western half of the road in the county.
The eastern half of the road features these tall exposed-rock cliffs that tower over the road.
text_zh: 台 8 線（中橫公路）從台中通往花蓮，其中花蓮段特別好認：該縣境內西半段整條路都設有**黃色護欄**。
東半段則是高聳的裸岩峭壁凌駕於道路之上。

text: The Provincial Highway 20, specifically the part that runs through **Yushan National Park**, features tall mountains covered with coniferous trees. The road also utilises these tube-like double guardrails.
NOTE: This road is only covered in Generation 2 and 4. The Generation 4 coverage is very overexposed and features sunny weather.
text_zh: 台 20 線（南橫公路）行經**玉山國家公園**的路段，兩側是覆滿針葉樹的高山，並採用這種管狀雙層護欄。
註：這條路只有第二代與第四代街景覆蓋。第四代的畫面曝光過度，且是晴天拍攝。

text: The road that leads up to Taipingshan National Forest in Yilan is distinct due to it often being **very foggy** when covered. Other features of this road include the coniferous trees and a guardrail with red legs.

NOTE: Certain parts of the roads feature a [sunset](https://www.google.com/maps/@?api=1&map_action=pano&pano=Guivd71mf24KYdvORBDNSA&viewpoint=24.515398%2C121.583108&heading=223.98270208148256&pitch=13.883893360213435&fov=133.16346058432444) in Generation 3.
text_zh: 宜蘭通往太平山國家森林遊樂區的道路特徵明顯：拍攝時經常**濃霧瀰漫**。此外還有針葉樹以及紅色支柱的護欄。

註：部分路段在第三代街景中會拍到[夕陽](https://www.google.com/maps/@?api=1&map_action=pano&pano=Guivd71mf24KYdvORBDNSA&viewpoint=24.515398%2C121.583108&heading=223.98270208148256&pitch=13.883893360213435&fov=133.16346058432444)。

text: Turkey uses both main types of guardrails:
- A-type guardrails, which have **rounded** edges.
- B-type guardrails, which have **square** edges.

While most Mediterranean countries use the A-type, B-type can help solve some tough 50-50s. Furthermore, seeing [both types](https://www.google.com/maps/@38.7634071,36.9889726,3a,75y,279.13h,72.18t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s-lWzgc6PumTFgOVCosSYkQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) will exclude all southern European and Middle Eastern countries, other than Montenegro and Israel & the West Bank. For a full overview of which guardrails are found in which European country, see [this infographic](/images/turkey/europeguardrail.png).
text_zh: 土耳其使用兩種主要類型的護欄：
- A 型護欄，邊緣呈**圓弧狀**。
- B 型護欄，邊緣呈**方形**。

雖然大多數地中海國家使用 A 型，但 B 型可以幫忙解決一些艱難的 50-50 猜題。此外，看到[兩種類型](https://www.google.com/maps/@38.7634071,36.9889726,3a,75y,279.13h,72.18t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s-lWzgc6PumTFgOVCosSYkQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)將能排除所有南歐和中東國家，蒙特內哥羅以及以色列和約旦河西岸除外。若要全面了解各個歐洲國家使用哪種護欄，請參閱[這張資訊圖表](/images/turkey/europeguardrail.png)。

text: Four-lane divided highways with **no divider**, other than double middle road lines, are almost exclusively found in the eastern half of the country.
Beware that divided highways with [clear dividers](https://goo.gl/maps/SLzhkGpReMShmtDt9), such as guardrails, can still be found in the east.
text_zh: 雙向四車道且 **沒有分隔島**（僅有雙黃線道路標線）的分隔公路，幾乎只分佈在該國的東半部。
請注意，在東部仍然可以找到帶有[清晰分隔設施](https://goo.gl/maps/SLzhkGpReMShmtDt9)（例如護欄）的分隔公路。

text: Street signs in Bursa are **green**, and generally have slightly **extruded letters**, meaning the signs are not completely flat.
NOTE: Several other types of infrastructure in Bursa, such as [fences](https://goo.gl/maps/EHzDyAUKLCQySbyB7) and [guardrails](https://goo.gl/maps/nF72j1rxibsT8weR8), may also be coloured green.
text_zh: 布爾薩的街道標誌為 **綠色**，且通常帶有微幅 **凸出的字體**，這意味著標誌並非完全平坦。
註：布爾薩的其他幾種基礎設施（例如[圍欄](https://goo.gl/maps/EHzDyAUKLCQySbyB7)與[護欄](https://goo.gl/maps/nF72j1rxibsT8weR8)）也可能漆成綠色。

text: Guardrails and barriers will often be painted **black and white**, similar to Russia.
text_zh: 護欄和欄杆通常會漆成**黑白相間**，類似於俄羅斯。

text: Guardrails, signs, and signposts are commonly painted a **medium brown colour** in US National Parks, which are often located in the west. Guardrails that are painted brown can be made out of both [wood](https://goo.gl/maps/syWa2BkK99zBRmzv5) and metal. [Rock walls](https://goo.gl/maps/bU1rFbRpVUP1LzRD7) can also sometimes be seen in place of guardrails.
[Here](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_national_parks_of_the_United_States#/map/0) you can find a map showing where all US National Parks are located.
NOTE: There are occasional exceptions to this rule, so consider other clues before guessing in a National Park.
text_zh: 在美國國家公園中，護欄、標誌和路標通常漆成**中棕色**，而這些國家公園大多位於西部。漆成棕色的護欄可以由[木頭](https://goo.gl/maps/syWa2BkK99zBRmzv5)和金屬製成。有時也能看到[石牆](https://goo.gl/maps/bU1rFbRpVUP1LzRD7)代替護欄。
[這裡](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_national_parks_of_the_United_States#/map/0)可以找到顯示所有美國國家公園位置的地圖。
注意：這項規則偶爾會有例外，因此在國家公園內盲猜之前，請先考慮其他線索。

text: Maine, New Hampshire, and Massachusetts use **small green and red rectangular signs** to mark the ends of bridges and guardrails.
NOTE: Not all bridges and guardrails in these states will have these markers.
text_zh: 緬因州、新罕布夏州和麻薩諸塞州使用**小型綠紅相間的長方形標誌**來標示橋樑和護欄的端點。
注意：這些州並非所有橋樑和護欄都有這些標示。

text: In Minnesota, these yellow signs with **vertical, black triangles** are placed before bridges at most major river crossings and at the beginnings and ends of guardrail sections on large highways.
text_zh: 在明尼蘇達州，這些帶有**垂直黑色三角形**的黃色標誌放置在多數主要河流交叉口的橋樑前，以及大型公路護欄區段的起點和終點。

text: **Square guardrails** are the most dominant (but not the only) type of guardrail in the states of New York and Wyoming. They have a long bar across the top, with several square legs supporting them.
NOTE: These guardrails can be found, to a lesser extent, in some adjacent states.
text_zh: **方形護欄**是紐約州和懷俄明州最主要（但非唯一）的護欄類型。它們頂部有一根長橫桿，並由數個方形支柱支撐。
注意：這些護欄在某些鄰近州也能找到，但數量較少。

text: Uruguayan guardrails have a small, rectangular yellow or red reflector, which is the same as in Argentina. They can be differentiated by the shape of their [support](/images/uruguay/argentinauruguay_guardrailsupport.jpg).
In Argentina, the supports are made up of three sides of a rectangle. Uruguayan supports have the same three sides, and additionally parts of the fourth side at the corners.
text_zh: 烏拉圭的護欄有一個小型、長方形的黃色或紅色反光片，這點和阿根廷相同。可以透過它們的[支撐結構](/images/uruguay/argentinauruguay_guardrailsupport.jpg)形狀來區分。
在阿根廷，支撐結構由長方形的三個側邊組成。烏拉圭的支撐結構有相同的三個側邊，並且在角落處額外帶有第四個側邊的部分結構。

text: Vietnam uses A-type guardrails. Instead of having just one colour, each reflector is **red** on one side and **yellow** on the other, making them very recognisable.
text_zh: 越南使用的是 A 型護欄。每個反光片不是只有單一顏色，而是一側為**紅色**，另一側為**黃色**，這使得它們非常容易辨識。
